name: The Blacksmith

topics.label: Ask about the forge going cold
topics.line: Why does the forge go cold some nights?
topics.goodText: "It went cold for a reason. Once. A long time ago." He stops. "Ask me again when you've earned it."

topics.label: Offer to help around the forge
topics.goodText: He hands you a broom without a word. Somehow that means yes.

topics.label: Compliment his work
topics.goodText: "It'll hold." Pause. "Probably." You're getting a discount and you both know it.

topics.label: Ask him to make something impossible
topics.line: Could you forge something that holds a spell?
topics.goodText: He looks at you for a long time. "...Come back tomorrow." He actually tries.

topics.label: Mention Jake
topics.line: Jake says he wants to learn smithing.
topics.goodText: "The kid with all the hobbies." A grunt. "Send him. One week. Then we'll see."
topics.badText: "Everyone wants to learn. Nobody wants to sweep."

gifts.likeText: He weighs it in his palm. "Good." High praise.

hangouts: You work the bellows in silence. It's the most comfortable silence you've had in town.
